name: Candy Blitz Bombs

features.name: Tumble multiplier reel
features.description: Rises by 1x per tumble and resets when tumbles end in the base game.

features.name: Multiplier bombs
features.description: Bombs worth 1x–500x add to the multiplier reel.

features.name: Non-resetting bonus
features.description: 10–14 free spins where multipliers keep building for the whole round.

review:
The Candy Blitz sequel, with reworked multipliers. A side reel's multiplier rises by 1x with each tumble and resets when they stop, and multiplier bombs worth 1x to 500x get added to it on cascades.

Four, five or six scatters give 10, 12 or 14 free spins, where bombs start at 2x and nothing resets for the whole round – that's where the 10,000x max comes into reach. 96.49% RTP, better than the original. A real upgrade, not a reskin.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
